works.body:
I request two illustrations of a shota boy and an idol girl.
The shota boy is a skinny rookie MMA club member who looks similar to:
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/135710795
The idol girl is an innocent-looking, black-haired, beautiful girl who looks similar to:
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/112341648

There are fighting shows at the school festival. The idol girl sings and dances between matches.
The shota boy's male opponent is sick and cannot attend.
So, the idol girl volunteers to fight the shota.

p1: The idol girl throws the shota like a judo-throw:
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/135781381

p2: Shota can't get up. Idol girl celebrates victory by dancing and singing on the ring, with Shota humiliatingly lying on his back on the ring.

Shota and the idol girl are of the same height.
Please freely design their clothes.
The idol girl may verbally tease the shota.

Thank you!
